name: Example widget

inputs.label: Title
inputs.description: The title at the top of the widget.
inputs.why: The widget shows it as its heading.

inputs.label: Habits folder
inputs.description: The folder with one file for each habit, such as meditate.json.
inputs.why: The widget shows your habits, and saves a check when you mark a habit done today.

inputs.label: Location
inputs.description: Your last location, from your phone.
inputs.why: The widget shows near which place you check your habits.

prompt: Habits live in {habits}, one JSON file for each habit. Before you create a habit file, ask the person once.
